newsitem.title: USA: Va. Power 781 MW Surry 2 resumes full output.
newsitem.headline: Va. Power 781 MW Surry 2 resumes full output.

text.p: The 781 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Surry nuclear generating complex resumed full power production after synchronizing to the grid Monday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The Gravel Neck, Va., unit was shut December 13 to replace a pipe section in its reactor coolant system.
The adjoining 781 MW Surry unit 1 was operating at 100 percent power, NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The Surry power units are operated by Virginia Power Co, a subsidiary of Dominion Resources.
